title: Torpor — Your Inbox, Summarized While You Sleep (Fully Local)
summary:
This is a submission for the Hacktoberfest Open-Source AI Challenge Week 3: Slow and Steady
What I Built
Point it at a JSON file of messages and it: embeds each one locally, scores it against a handful of "this needs a human" reference phrases by meaning (not keyword matching), splits messages into "needs you" vs. "can wait" using the inbox's own score distribution, and asks a local model to write a genuine 2–3 sentence summary of what actually matters.
Demo
$ ollama pull qwen3:8b
torpor: barely
